17-year-old NDA Cadet Dies After Training Parade, Third Death in a Year

A 17-year-old National Democratic Alliance (NDA) cadet died after participating in a training parade in Pune, Maharashtra. This is the third death of an NDA cadet in a year, highlighting concerns about the safety and well-being of young recruits. The incident has sparked debate about the risks associated with military training and the need for improved safety measures.
